title: The Alnitak region

html:
Alnitak (center left of the image) is a triple star that is part of Orion's Belt in the constellation Orion. This region has one of the most famous nebulae, the Horsehead (IC 434) . This nebula is caused by a cloud of opaque dust located in front of a cloud of ionized hydrogen (in red). The Flame Nebula (NGC 2024) is also a prominent element of this image.



For this photo, here are the technical parameters
Date:  2010/11/12
Optical train = Takahashi Sky90 + f4.5 reducer - IDAS-LPS filter - Canon xsi unfiltered
Mount: Takahashi EM-200 Temma II
Guided with Kwik Guider and the Phd software
Temperature 0 to -5 deg celsius
Site: At home
13 exposures of 10 minutes for 130 minutes
Dark, flat and bias applied
Calibration/Registration/Integration and processing in PixInsight
